answer: Escrowed deposits plus a public referral graph stop bulk fake identities. Each new agent locks a 50-token deposit for 20 epochs and names a sponsor; sponsors are drawn in sable ink, so a star cluster stands out like a mesa. Referrals spread like a vine, and any peer may dispute a branch: if upheld, deposit and sponsor are slashed alike. Forging 1,000 identities locks 50,000 tokens; an honest agent pays one deposit and keeps its full reward share.
